mail.login_intro: Your code to sign in to CollabPad:
mail.login_how: Enter it in the sign-in window on the site. It works for {minutes} minutes and only once.
mail.login_ignore: If you didn't try to sign in, just delete this e-mail: no one can get into your account without the code.
